identity.name: Llama 4
identity.one_liner: Meta's flagship open MoE model family with Scout (109B, 10M context) and Maverick (400B, rivaling GPT-5 on coding).
identity.short_description: Meta's flagship open MoE model family with Scout (109B, 10M context) and Maverick (400B, rivaling GPT-5 on coding).

positioning.why_it_matters: Llama 4 represents Meta's latest open MoE model family, with Scout offering an unprecedented 10M token context window and Maverick rivaling GPT-5 on coding benchmarks, making it a top contender for open model evaluation.
best_for: Developers evaluating open MoE models with extreme long-context needs
Teams comparing Llama 4 Maverick against GPT-5 for coding and reasoning workloads
Builders who need a permissively licensed open model with multiple size variants
not_for: Teams that cannot review the Llama 4 Community License terms before deployment
Use cases requiring verified multimodal input beyond text-based reasoning
